calibrationReview.note: The archived OPEN and MAIN lanes issued no BET risk; final repricing is compared without outcome-chasing or duplicate exposure.

recommendations.title: San Francisco Giants moneyline
recommendations.mechanism: Two-book MLB repricing tests whether retail improvement outpaces fair-value movement.
recommendations.limitation: Price and fair moved together, leaving no cushion.
recommendations.displayText: B — direct MLB moneyline/no-vig evidence fits; synchronized price/fair movement leaves no cushion.

recommendations.title: Toronto Blue Jays moneyline
recommendations.mechanism: Fresh single-book MLB no-vig assesses an adverse same-day repricing.
recommendations.limitation: The second book fails freshness and the offer is below fair.
recommendations.displayText: B — direct MLB moneyline evidence fits; one-book calibration and adverse repricing are cautionary.

recommendations.title: Atlanta Braves moneyline
recommendations.mechanism: Single-book MLB no-vig preserves a conservative fair baseline when line shopping is unavailable.
recommendations.limitation: Only one supported quote remains and it is above fair.
recommendations.displayText: B — direct MLB no-vig evidence fits; one-book calibration and no price cushion reduce confidence.

recommendations.title: St. Louis Cardinals moneyline
recommendations.mechanism: Fresh single-book MLB calibration evaluates price close to first pitch.
recommendations.limitation: The second-book row is stale and the current price is negative value.
recommendations.displayText: B — direct MLB moneyline calibration fits; stale second-book evidence cannot improve the grade.

recommendations.title: Beşiktaş–Kauno Žalgiris draw
recommendations.mechanism: Two-book 1X2 no-vig and line shopping identify a draw-price residual.
recommendations.limitation: Longshot margin allocation and playoff-specific calibration are uncertain.
recommendations.displayText: C — soccer 1X2 and margin evidence fits; playoff specificity and longshot-margin risk limit transfer.

recommendations.title: Lech Poznań–FC Thun draw
recommendations.mechanism: Single-book three-way no-vig assesses a tracked playoff draw after loss of the better book.
recommendations.limitation: One-book calibration is weak and the current offer is well below fair.
recommendations.displayText: C — soccer 1X2 evidence is relevant; one-book playoff calibration is weak and price is plainly short.

recommendations.title: Vasalunds–IFK Norrköping draw
recommendations.mechanism: Two-book 1X2 comparison tests a large preliminary-round draw discrepancy.
recommendations.limitation: Book disagreement and cup-specific calibration materially weaken the residual.
recommendations.displayText: C — soccer market-efficiency evidence is related; cup-round and league-specific calibration is limited.
